description: Tier A enforcement map (DECISION-GATE C-1). Every Tier A rule from AGENTS.md 'Enforcement Tiers' MUST map to >=1 mechanical guard script on the working tree. The meta-guard scripts/enforce-guard-wiring.js verifies this file: unmapped Tier A rules, missing guard files, or unreferenced guard:* scripts fail the gate.

guardScriptAllowlist.guard:api-ssot: delegates to lint:no-api-string-literals (not a standalone script file)
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:audit: npm audit invocation, no script file
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:circular: madge CLI invocation, no script file
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:dependencies: depcruise CLI invocation, no script file
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:duplicate-code: jscpd CLI invocation, no script file
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:license: license-checker CLI invocation, no script file
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:pr-description: CI-only PR metadata check (scripts/ci/verify-pr-description.js); not part of the working-tree gate
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:pr-impact-analysis: PR-description check; invoked manually per README, not wired to a workflow — allowlisted pending a CI-wiring decision (out of C-1 scope)
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:runtime-parity: Manual runtime parity check; not wired into gate/CI — allowlisted
guardScriptAllowlist.guard:core-export-parity: Export-vs-dist parity check; run manually after core builds, not wired into gate/CI — allowlisted
